description: Land Acquisition - Kalubowila, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Nugegoda, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the government's acquisition of multiple land parcels for creating a water reserve. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their locations, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
